# key: # The first six tests are field controls next to the new rule that keep the value their Visible had at open, on BC and on
# main: controls bound to a field of the source table, and Visible expressions that name only a page variable or a

# whose handler reads no such Visible runs here and is refused at the open on main; the one whose handler reads it is
# refused on both, here at the Visible read. On main it also carries the transaction-type flags, since the tests refused
# before it leave the type unknown; here those tests run to their end.

entry: REFUSED a Card with a field control bound to no field whose Visible names a field of the record, opened in a way the probe did not measure
